verdict.rationale: Docs show BVNK abstracts blockchain complexity via a REST API — wallets, quotes, payment rules, and blockchain addresses are all managed through endpoints (bvnk-docs-4, -5, -23, -26) with Hawk-based auth (bvnk-docs-29) and a sandbox for safe testing (bvnk-docs-31), so developers never touch nodes or gas directly. However, evidence only shows one CLI tool (bvnk-probe-2) rather than client libraries across multiple languages, so the 'client libraries in my language' part of the story is unconfirmed. Missing for 10: multi-language SDKs/client libraries, explicit statement of gas/node abstraction.
